items.title: Tree removal
items.text: Hazardous and unwanted trees taken down safely, with certified arborists on site.

items.title: Stump removal
items.text: Stump grinding and removal by our own stump grinder operator.

items.title: Pruning & trimming
items.text: An expert evaluation, then pruning that keeps each tree healthy and in scale with its spot.

items.title: Cabling, rodding & bracing
items.text: Extra support for storm-damaged or aging trees that are still worth saving.

items.title: Lightning protection
items.text: Protection systems installed, inspected and repaired, including after roof work.

items.title: Tree wound repair
items.text: Care for damaged bark and wounds before they become bigger problems.

items.text: They came out quickly to give me a very reasonable quote to remove three trees, grind a stump and trim some bushes. The work was completed in a safe and timely manner.
Joe has solved my tree issues on three occasions. Every time he quotes a fair price, arrives when he says he will, and does a great job, including the cleanup! Top notch.
Knowledgeable, courteous, and answered all my questions before the job was started. They did an excellent clean job after removing all my trees and stumps.
